name: Read-only view shows the viewed branch's sessions
description: When reviewing a branch/PR read-only, the Sessions tab and badge now read sessions committed on the viewed branch's git ref instead of the checked-out branch's working-tree sessions, mirroring how the read-only diff reads file content from refs.

steps.title: Read sessions from a git ref (core)
steps.body: Sessions are committed into the branch, so reviewing read-only means reading that ref's manifests from git's object store rather than the working tree. Adds `listSessionsAtRef`/`getSessionAtRef`/`countSessionsAtRef`, built on `git ls-tree` (list manifest names) and `git show` (read one manifest), each tolerating a missing ref/dir by returning empty — the read-only counterparts of the existing disk readers.

steps.title: Thread an optional ref through the boundary
steps.body: The `session` DiffContext gains `ref?` so an open session's frozen diff reads from the viewed ref too. The IPC handlers (`sessions:list/get/count`, plus the session branches of `git:listChangedFiles`/`git:getDiff`) and the preload + PreloadAPI types accept an optional `ref`: when set, the *AtRef readers run; otherwise the disk readers (the checked-out branch, picking up not-yet-committed CLI saves).

steps.title: Drive the ref from the view state (renderer)
steps.body: A `sessionRef()` helper resolves the ref the same way the Branch tab resolves its head: `pr/<n>/head` for a PR view, the view branch for a branch view, else null (disk). `loadSessions`, `openSession`, `contextForTab`, and `refreshSessionCount` use it, and the `viewBranchReadOnly`/`viewPRReadOnly`/`returnToCheckedOutBranch` switches now refresh the badge and reload the on-screen list so the list, open tour, and badge all follow the viewed branch.
